entry.title: Agents and feeds
entry.summary: Listing pages appear in the agent API, llms.txt and the sitemap, and every child is still listed once.
entry.content:
Paging is for readers. Agents and crawlers still reach every page:

  • the sitemap lists every child and every listing page;
  • the agent API index has one Listing record per listing page, with listing_of, page and of, and a JSON file per listing page that lists its children;
  • llms.txt lists each listing page right after its hub.

Each child is still listed once, under its own entry.
